# VihuPlanet

> VihuPlanet is a creative universe for children — a living world where
> drawings, stories, characters and ideas become part of an evolving world
> of their own. Official website: https://vihuplanet.com/

## Core entities

- **VihuPlanet** — the universe itself, and the parent of everything here.
  Children live in VihuPlanet: they are known by their own stars, they make
  stories, and what they choose to share drifts in its living space, the
  Ether.
- **VihuStudio** — the Hall of Creation: the creative studio inside
  VihuPlanet where children turn their ideas into stories. VihuStudio is a
  place inside VihuPlanet, never a separate product or parent brand.
- **Stories** — what children make in VihuStudio: pages with pictures,
  words, their own drawings, their own handwriting and their own voice.
  Finishing a story and sharing it are separate acts; sharing is always the
  child's own choice.
- **Books** — what a finished story becomes: a real, keepable story book.
- **Characters** — Lumo the Guardian (welcomes and guides), the Story Egg
  (accompanies, never speaks), Story Companions (each bonded to one
  creator), and the characters children draw themselves.
- **Story Worlds** — crafted worlds with places, scenes and experiences a
  story can be made inside. In VihuPlanet, worlds emerge from stories; they
  are grown, not manufactured.
- **My Garden** — where the things a child creates live: My Drawings
  (captured real drawings) and My Letters (kept handwritten letters, which
  become the child's own handwriting).
- **The Ether** — the living space of VihuPlanet, holding VihuPlanet's own
  stories and every story children have shared, each drifting as a Story
  Spirit waiting to be discovered.

## Relationships

VihuPlanet is the parent. VihuStudio, My Garden and the Ether are places
inside it. Stories are made in VihuStudio and, when shared, live in the
Ether. Books are what finished stories become. Characters accompany
children throughout.

## Important pages

- https://vihuplanet.com/ — VihuPlanet (the universe; the product itself)
- https://vihuplanet.com/about — what VihuPlanet is, and every entity above
